package handlers_test

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	studenthttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/student"
	apiv1 "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/transport/http/api/v1/middleware"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/nextbestaction"
)

func TestAuthoritativeNextActionWithCurrentLiveStudent(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("NBA_PROOF_STUDENT_ID"))
	baseURL := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("NBA_LIVE_STUDENT_URL"))
	token := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("NBA_LIVE_TEACHER_TOKEN"))
	if studentID == "" || baseURL == "" || token == "" {
		t.Skip("NBA_PROOF_STUDENT_ID, NBA_LIVE_STUDENT_URL and NBA_LIVE_TEACHER_TOKEN required")
	}
	client := studenthttp.Client{BaseURL: baseURL, LearningWorkspaceToken: token, HTTPClient: &http.Client{Timeout: 2 * time.Second}}
	owner, err := client.GetNextAction(context.Background(), studentID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	response := serveNextActionForStudent(nextbestaction.Get{Enabled: true, Actions: client}, studentID)
	require.Equal(t, http.StatusOK, response.Code, response.Body.String())
	expected, err := json.Marshal(owner)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, string(expected), response.Body.String())
	require.Equal(t, "no-store", response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"))
}

// TestNextBestActionWithLiveStudentHTTP exercises the real strict Student
// client, deterministic use case, and authenticated public Teacher handler.
// It is opt-in because the Student base URL and dedicated Teacher token are
// supplied only by the isolated S10 disposable acceptance topology.
func TestNextBestActionWithLiveStudentHTTP(t *testing.T) {
	studentBaseURL := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("S10_STUDENT_LIVE_BASE_URL"))
	studentToken := strings.TrimSpace(os.Getenv("S10_STUDENT_TEACHER_TOKEN"))
	if studentBaseURL == "" || studentToken == "" {
		t.Skip("S10_STUDENT_LIVE_BASE_URL and S10_STUDENT_TEACHER_TOKEN are required for live Student acceptance")
	}

	for _, testCase := range []struct {
		name      string
		studentID string
		status    int
		kind      string
		lessonID  string
		errorCode string
	}{
		{
			name: "ready lesson starts", studentID: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
			status: http.StatusOK, kind: "START_LESSON", lessonID: "40000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001",
		},
		{
			name: "in progress lesson continues", studentID: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
			status: http.StatusOK, kind: "CONTINUE_LESSON", lessonID: "40000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002",
		},
		{
			name: "terminal path is managed", studentID: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003",
			status: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name: "no selected path is not ready", studentID: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000004",
			status: http.StatusOK,
		},
		{
			name: "inconsistent selected path is unavailable", studentID: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000005",
			status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, errorCode: "nba_state_unavailable",
		},
		{
			name: "cross student selected path is unavailable", studentID: "10000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000006",
			status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable, errorCode: "nba_state_unavailable",
		},
	} {
		t.Run(testCase.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			client := studenthttp.Client{
				BaseURL:                studentBaseURL,
				LearningWorkspaceToken: studentToken,
				HTTPClient:             &http.Client{Timeout: 2 * time.Second},
			}
			response := serveNextActionForStudent(
				nextbestaction.Get{Enabled: true, Actions: client},
				testCase.studentID,
			)
			require.Equal(t, testCase.status, response.Code, response.Body.String())
			require.Equal(t, "no-store", response.Header().Get("Cache-Control"))
			if testCase.errorCode != "" {
				require.JSONEq(t, `{"error":"`+testCase.errorCode+`"}`, response.Body.String())
				return
			}
			require.Contains(t, response.Body.String(), `"schema":"student-next-action.v1"`)
			if testCase.kind != "" {
				require.Contains(t, response.Body.String(), `"kind":"`+testCase.kind+`"`)
			}
			if testCase.lessonID != "" {
				require.Contains(t, response.Body.String(), `"lesson_id":"`+testCase.lessonID+`"`)
			}
		})
	}
}

func serveNextActionForStudent(getter interface {
	Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherNextAction, error)
}, studentID string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
	api := apiv1.NewRouter(
		&handlers.PersonalTeacherHandler{}, &handlers.TeacherDialogHandler{}, nil, nil, nil, nil,
		&handlers.NextBestActionHandler{Getter: getter},
	)
	router := chi.NewRouter()
	router.Use(middleware.AuthMiddleware)
	router.Mount("/", api)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/teacher/me/next-action", nil)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-ID", studentID)
	request.Header.Set("X-User-Role", "STUDENT")
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	return response
}
